g.text: The manager container is rebuilt and recreated: its web UI is
unavailable for a short time and terminals or captures open in it end.
Lab containers keep running. A first setup asks you to create the
Manager data, saved passwords, the clab-backup-ui/.env settings
(or the defaults: all VM interfaces, port 8081) and every lab
Install missing prerequisites: Git, SSH, Docker/Compose and
Check UTC/NTP before APT; wait briefly for active time sync without
Retain compatible installed tools; start Docker and SSH services.
Prepare persistent storage and restricted clab-discovery
